rows.notes: The cited document is a systematic literature review (Sensors 2024, 24, 6313) of remote sensing and AI techniques for crop water stress evaluation; it reports no data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own (Section 2 describes a literature search and selection of 46 papers). It therefore fails Q1. Moreover, its subject is crop water stress detection via RGB, thermal, CWSI and hyperspectral imaging with ML/DL models; it contains nothing on AI-driven decision support systems for managing nitrogen levels or mitigating salinity impacts, which is the claimed effect. Salinity appears only incidentally in the summary of one reviewed study (Das et al. [63], wheat on sodic soils), and nitrogen only in the title of Mao et al. [114]; neither is an own result nor relevant to the claim.
